# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 109 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 109 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_109_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 26

**1** "Lord, now that you have explained all these things to me, tell me this also: why did the tower not appear to be built on level ground, but on a rock and on water?" **2** He said to me: "You are wise to ask about the foundation. **3** This is why the foundation of the tower was laid on the rock and on the water: because your life was saved and shall be saved through water, and the tower was founded on the word of the Almighty and glorious Name; and it is the Name of the Lord that upholds the whole creation. **4** So that the tower, founded on the word of the glorious Name, might stand firm forever, unshaken by any storm of adversity or affliction." **5** I said: "Lord, this is great and marvelous. But tell me further: **6** why were those who repented given first place in the tower, while those who had not repented were placed in the outer parts?" **7** He said: "Because they repented first upon hearing the call of repentance, and therefore they were placed nearest to the gate. They were the first to believe after the Son of God was made manifest to them." **8** "Tell me, Lord," I said, "what the seal signifies which was given to those who entered through the gate." **9** "The seal is water," he said. "They go down into the water dead, and they come up from it alive. **10** Therefore the seal was also proclaimed to these, that they should enter the kingdom of God." **11** He said to me: "Now go and tell those who are with you the great and glorious things of God which you have seen; and let these words not be withheld from them." **12** He showed me all these things clearly; then I fell asleep, and he departed from me.

---

*LOGOS: the commission to Hermas in v. 11 formally concludes Similitude 9 and sets up Similitude 10. The sleep-departure pattern frames the entire vision as a dream revelation.*
